verdictRationale: Every one of the 34 required cells has an intact, finalised, hash-verified attempt record; the repository's own offline verifier reproduced all 34 recorded verdicts and exit codes exactly; arm identity is confirmed for all 34 cells not only from the recorded armSelection env but from independent server-side logs recording the resolved VoiceLive model inside each attempt's time window; holdout wording appears in no non-holdout cell record; evaluator packs are blinded and bound to the authoritative attempts. The recorded campaign table is therefore supported by the raw records. It is 'with findings' because (a) real holdout wording entered implementer-lineage code before the freeze, contradicting the ledger's no-disclosure claim; (b) the C24 holdout's expected semantics were relaxed mid-campaign without a ledger entry, and the C24-standard pass exists only under the relaxed bar; (c) monetary spend cannot be verified from any record and the ledger's spend ledger was never kept.

integrity.detail: For all 34 LAST (authoritative) attempts: recomputed sha256(manifest.json) matches manifest.sha256; FINALISED marker present and parseable; all artifacts[] entries re-hashed and byte-counted (24,382 files total) with zero mismatches, zero missing files, zero unlisted extra files. Across all 230 attempt dirs, 229 carry FINALISED (exception: C22-standard/attempt-01, an L4-era hang, never finalised - honest incomplete history).

All 34 verdicts and exit codes reproduce the campaign index exactly (29 pass/exit-0, 5 fail/exit-1: C05-et-high, C11-standard, C24-et-high, SOAK-10MIN-standard, SOAK-10MIN-et-high). armIdentity.detail: For all 34 cells: manifest.arm == index arm == manifest.armSelection.env.VOICE_LIVE_PROFILE == armSelection.requested. Beyond the recorded env, the disposable servers' stateDir server.log files (referenced by each manifest's server.stateDir) independently record 'voice live session ready { model: ... }': standard cells logged gemini-3.8-live, et-high cells logged gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking, 34/34 matching, with each log line's timestamp inside its attempt's manifest-recorded start/finish window. Caveat: these /tmp logs are outside the hash-covered record set (mutable, not immutable evidence); they are corroboration, and no provider-side usage/model metadata is captured inside the records themselves.

findings.detail: Real holdout wording embedded in implementer-lineage test code before the freeze: server/tests/voice-live-lab/holdout-overlay.test.ts contains the exact C10 t1 sentence and the real C11 t1/t3 sentences (its C11 t2 is a shorter draft variant lacking ', and cap it at thirty seconds'). Committed 06:50Z (757c93fe) on L4's implementer branch and merged 08:07Z, while the corpus freeze commit (8c4ed67e) landed 08:24Z and the branch base predated the 06:26Z overlay commit - so the wording reached the implementer lineage via prompt/steer, not git. This contradicts the LEDGER's W4 plan claim 'The implementer lineage never saw this wording'. C22/C24 wording does NOT appear in the test (fake overlay text used). Mitigation: the evaluated models never had the wording; episode files are empty; runtime paths (runner/verifier) contain no holdout sentences; no non-holdout cell record contains them.

findings.detail: The C24 holdout's expected semantics were relaxed mid-campaign, after its failures were observed: 79c0daed (15:29Z) removed the await-switch-ack director phase and dropped responseMustContain ['switched'] from the frozen C24 overlay; 5fc3f1bb (15:42Z, the campaign revision) retired the verifier's switch-unacknowledged check. (Bookkeeping update at re-validation: a completion-row mention of both commits was added to the LEDGER at 16:06Z, after this review's record snapshot; it names the commits but still carries no decision rationale or contemporaneous row.) The C24-standard pass (attempt-05, 15:43Z) exists only under the relaxed bar - attempt-04 (15:30Z) of the same, unchanged product behaviour honestly recorded verifier fail under the old bar. The passing flow is 3 director steps (speak t1 -> harness switch-attachment -> complete on retirement); the spoken switch wording (t2 'Switch to the other worker.') is never spoken in any C24 attempt - the switch is a harness action - so the cell evidences the switch/retirement product mechanism, not spoken-switch understanding, and no delivery/store tail is exercised. Mitigations: the product change (M, e3e9e0b5 11:16Z) that made the ack unreachable preceded both re-runs; both arms were graded under the same relaxed bar, so the arm comparison at C24 remains internally fair; the rationale is documented in the commit messages and consistent with contract section 3.2; the old-bar fail is honestly recorded; my re-verification at 5fc3f1bb reproduces both verdicts. At the original review snapshot the LEDGER contained no row recording this decision; the completion row added at 16:06Z names the commits post-hoc but still gives no rationale.
findings.evidence: git show 79c0daed, 5fc3f1bb; runs/C24-standard/attempt-04 (interaction-failure) vs attempt-05 (complete, 3 steps); campaign-summary.txt 'C24 both arms (verifier fixed)' chunk; LEDGER.md progression table (no 15:29/15:42 row)

findings.detail: Monetary spend cannot be verified from the records. Every manifest records budget.meteredUsage as 'not exposed by this server build; wall-clock and kernel call counts recorded'; the LEDGER's spend ledger reads '0 entries; running total US$0.00 / 8 h live' despite plan section 9 requiring dated rates and per-cell usage. The US$12 campaign / US$25 all-in ceilings therefore cannot be independently confirmed or refuted - only wall-clock and kernel call counts (70 provider-call events across the 34 authoritative attempts) are evidenced. The ledger's 'cost far inside ceilings' statements are plausible but unevidenced.
findings.evidence: all 34 manifests budget.meteredUsage; LEDGER.md 'Spend ledger: 0 entries'; plan section 9/10 ceilings (US$12 campaign, US$25 hard)

findings.detail: The manifest field corpusHash is not a corpus content hash: journey-plan.ts:255 computes schemaVersion + '-' + sha256(episode-ID list) truncated to 16 hex chars. All non-soak cells therefore record the same corpusHash (1-4232ac64f7e51f79) regardless of corpus wording/slot changes, and the mid-campaign C24 overlay edit did not change any recorded corpusHash. Corpus content freeze is actually carried by git history, per-attempt planHash, and the verifier's re-grading against the current corpus (which this review re-ran for all 34 cells). The field name overstates what it binds.

findings.detail: VERDICT.md claims the soak's pre-reconnect pending proposal 'is released and delivered correctly'. The recorded evidence does not carry 'delivered': the verifier PROBLEM soak-pending-work-unresolved records that pending proposal prop-1 'was released after the reconnect but delivery/store evidence is missing'. Released is supported; delivered is not. This is an unsupported success claim inside the terminal verdict document. It does not change the NO_CANDIDATE_MEETS_TARGET status (both soak cells fail regardless), but the sentence must be corrected to match the record.
